acceptance_criteria.text: Factory-only creation preparation returns reviewable final bytes, relationships and canonical hash, retains an exact proposal without publication/grant, and requires new approval after any prepared-content change. Shared canonical validation enforces 1–5 artifacts, nonblank valid UTF-8 titles of 1–256 bytes and bodies of 1–65,536 bytes after preparation, at most 16 positive link targets, linked-without-parent or attach-to-source relationships; linking is the default and attachment must be explicitly reviewed.

Creation is hidden/refused with gate off and refused outside Research or without a valid live attempt-bound grant; arguments, GitHub content, arbitrary tokens and comment volume cannot grant permission or expose the private permit.

Creation refuses absent/expired/reused/mismatched grants, changed exact content/source/relationship, stale attempts and wrong approval provenance using the existing primitive; accepted reservation/dispatch never reimplements its authorization or quota decisions.

Creation enforces existing attempt/repository caps and expiry, isolates repository budgets and retains charges for uncertain/partial outcomes; repeated, concurrent and spam-like identical calls reconcile one operation with at most one dispatch owner. Existing limits are one batch/five artifacts per attempt, twenty artifacts per repository rolling 24 hours, and 30-minute approval expiry bounded by the lease. Expired grants refuse dispatch/replay; independently authorized receipt reads remain possible.

A valid fixture-bound grant publishes only reviewed artifacts and relationships, returns confirmed per-artifact identities, and persists partial/lost-response/restart outcomes without blind recreation or full-batch confirmation while unresolved.

When the loaded allow_mcp_story_creation setting is omitted or false, creation is hidden from discovery and refused server-side, including a direct call with an otherwise valid fixture-bound live grant. Reuse the existing default-off configuration and authorization primitive; family registration must not enable the gate implicitly.
